title: GuidedWAM: Training-Free Energy Guidance for World Action Models in Autonomous Driving
abstract: arXiv:2611.07912v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: World action models (WAMs) for autonomous driving couple the driving policy and the visual world model in a single generative network whose objectives are fixed post-training. Conditioning on a new driving objective requires retraining. We study energy guidance as a general mechanism and present GuidedWAM, a model-agnostic framework for injecting driving objectives into frozen WAMs at sampling time. Our framework constructs each objective as differentiable energies on the sampler's intermediate clean-action estimate, which needs only forward access to the frozen model, and is stabilized by sampling-time guidance scheduling, per-energy normalization, and velocity-bounded correction. On the NAVSIM v2 hard-split, guidance improves all three frozen, publicly released WAMs by 1.8 to 3.6 EPDMS, averaged over three sampler seeds, and adds less than 10% to the sampling time per step. translated_title: GuidedWAM：面向自动驾驶世界动作模型的无训练能量引导
translated_abstract: 面向自动驾驶的世界动作模型（WAMs）将驾驶策略与视觉世界模型耦合在单一的生成网络中，其优化目标在训练完成后即被固定，若要针对新的驾驶目标进行条件化控制则必须重新训练。我们研究能量引导作为一种通用机制，并提出GuidedWAM——一个与模型无关的框架，能够在采样阶段将驾驶目标注入到冻结的WAM中。我们的框架将每个目标构造为作用于采样器中间干净动作估计上的可微能量，这只需要对冻结模型进行前向访问即可，并通过采样时的引导调度、逐能量归一化以及速度受限校正来保证稳定性。在NAVSIM v2难例分割上，该引导方法使三个冻结的已公开发布WAM在三个采样器种子下的平均EPDMS提升1.8至3.6分，且每步采样时间增加不足10%。这些结果表明，能量引导可作为一种实用的后训练机制。
tldr: 提出GuidedWAM，一种无需重新训练的与模型无关的能量引导框架，可在采样时将新驾驶目标注入冻结的自动驾驶世界动作模型，在NAVSIM v2难例集上平均提升1.8至3.6 EPDMS，且每步采样开销不足10%。
